snippet.title: NITRO GEN OMEGA 1.0 Release Date Trailer | Pre-Order now!
snippet.description:
1.0 & Consoles coming out on May 12th - Get it now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2525510/NITRO_GEN_OMEGA/
----
Pre-Order on PlayStation: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2525510/NITRO_GEN_OMEGA/
----
Pre-Order on Xbox: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2525510/NITRO_GEN_OMEGA/
----
Pre-Order on Epic Games Store: https://store.epicgames.com/p/nitro-gen-omega-9da562
----
Pre-Order on Nintendo Switch: https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/nitro-gen-omega-switch/

A sandbox tactical RPG of steel, fire, friendship, and shonen anime. Assemble your crew, customize your Mech, and lead them in cinematic turn-based battles through a world ruled by rogue AI. The bonds you forge will decide who survives!
